Title: Develop backend API to serve inventory
Description: Create a RESTful API in Express to return inventory grouped by machine and product.
Acceptance Criteria:
- /vending/inventory returns machine, product, price, quantity
- Error handling for DB issues
- Supports future expansion

Title: Build frontend inventory listing (React Native)
Description: List products grouped by machine with quantity and price using Expo + Axios.
Acceptance Criteria:
- FlatList of items from API
- Machine + product displayed
- Quantity and price shown clearly

Title: Develop cart management logic (frontend)
Description: Use Zustand store for managing cart contents with add/remove/clear features.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Items can be added/removed from cart
- Item quantity can be incremented
- Clear cart resets all items
